name: Texts From HSS
source:
It's not winter break yet, but love is in the air! Can you help one of your friends stay warm for the winter when she shares her secret crush?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Texts_From_HSS]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
虽然还没到寒假，但空气中却弥漫着爱的气息！当你的一位朋友分享她的秘密暗恋时，你能帮助她保暖过冬吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Texts_From_HSS]Choices Wikia[/url]]
